name: grotto
prompt: A tall arched natural rock grotto frame for an indoor waterfall: two rugged stacked mossy boulder pillars and a heavy rock lintel forming a tall rectangular opening in the middle (the opening is empty, no water), ferns and moss tufts on the ledges, small hanging vines, dark wet stone with green moss.

name: pond
prompt: The rim of a small natural swamp garden pond seen from above at an angle: an oval ring of mossy rounded river stones and gnarled roots enclosing an EMPTY flat dark centre, clumps of ferns, cattails and reeds and a few small glowing orange mushrooms growing among the stones, no water surface, no bridge.

name: sofa
prompt: A large antique chesterfield sofa, deep button-tufted dark brown leather, rolled arms, studded brass nailheads, carved dark wooden feet, slightly worn cosy tavern style.

name: armchair
prompt: An antique wingback armchair, deep button-tufted dark green leather, rolled arms, brass nailheads, carved dark wooden legs, cosy old tavern style.

name: barrel
prompt: An old wooden ale barrel standing upright, dark oak staves with iron hoops, a little moss at the base, a brass tap on the front.

name: cardtable
prompt: A round antique wooden card table with a green felt top, thick carved pedestal leg, a few playing cards and chips on the felt, warm dark wood, old saloon style.

name: stool
prompt: A rustic round wooden bar stool with a dark leather padded seat, three splayed legs with an iron foot ring, tavern style.

name: booth
prompt: A rustic swamp market stall booth made of dark weathered timber: a wide wooden counter, two posts, a sloping roof with a dark green and gold striped fabric awning with scalloped edge, small hanging lanterns, shelves with goods behind the counter, moss on the roof, front view.

name: fireplace
prompt: A large rustic stone fireplace hearth for a tavern wall: rough mossy fieldstone surround, a thick dark timber mantel beam with candles and a few bottles, iron log grate with glowing embers inside, front view.
